name: Fibble: Flick 'n' Roll
summary: Fibble is a physics-driven puzzler where the player's job is to guide a ball-like alien through several levels. The game is a mixture of the mechanics of mini-golf and pinball. Fibble crash-lands on Earth, but before the impact he managed to eject his crew. During his journey he seeks the crew members and collects components of his spaceship. Players can use the found crew members (Byte, Docto, Vroom, Ragno and Klonk) to help Fibble reaching the target by placing them onto the level. Each crew member has a special ability that can change Fibble’s path and they are also used to collect all the stars in the levels.
